text: The service providers MSCI Inc. and its subsidiary company MSCI ESG Research LLC (MSCI) has been hired as the primary provider of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting over the last three years. The services provided by MSCI responds to a request by City Council, at its meetings in June 29 and June 30, 2020, to monitor and report on whether external investment firms hired by the Board are compliant with the terms of the Investment Policy with respect to ESG factors. Both MSCI products are being provided on a managed service basis whereby City staff provide portfolio information to MSCI via secured channels and MSCI generate reports on a portfolio and consolidated basis for the Long-Term Fund (LTF) and Sinking Fund (SF). The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1, Confidential Attachment 2, Confidential Attachment 3, and Confidential Attachment 4 to the report (November 26, 2025) remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information that involves the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations. 2. Authorized the Director, Capital Markets to negotiate a contract to retain services provided by MSCI Inc. and MSCI ESG Research LLC to supply quarterly reporting and metrics for the purposes of assessing Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance in relation to the Board's investments, and to authorize the Chair or Vice-Chair of the Toronto Investment Board to execute an agreement with these service providers on behalf of the Toronto Investment Board.
